title: research(rank7): certify precision-40 κ above PR3133
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This is a precision-only refinement of PR #3133's unchanged rank-7 coupled words, literal T74 allocation and paid profile. The certified root endpoint moves from 24 to 40 decimal places:

- `C40 = 0.0017297760894051203342384678198935738683`
- `κ = C40 - 10^-86 - 10^-62`

The resulting exact finite claim exceeds PR #3133's public claim by `46781989357386830000009999999999999999000000009999999999999999 / 10^86` (about `4.6782e-25`). The construction and selected frontier do not change; the selected κ remains `0.001672660197076918`. This is a conditional finite candidate, not an all-size theorem or a selected-frontier update.

## Task and overlap

Task card `complex-new-helper-inventory`, priority revision 6; scope changed to refine only the certified endpoint of the existing T74 candidate, as recorded in the package `TASK.json`. The PR's base commit is `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`. Its exact construction dependency is PR #3133 at source commit `51eb9c4ee9e4722010d308aa3309e039d3940cc2`; source bindings and receipts are recorded in `SOURCES.json` and `evidence/`.

[PR #3133](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3133) is the unchanged construction being refined. [PR #3136](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3136) independently audited the parent words but does not contain this endpoint refinement. The full predecessor lineage is retained in `CREDITS.md`; no construction from concurrent packages is imported.

## Validation

The registered environment is CPython 3.12.15 with `gmpy2` 2.3.2, `mpmath` 1.3.0, NumPy 1.26.4, SciPy 1.15.3 and SymPy 1.14.0. Run from a full repository clone containing the pinned source Git objects:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-coupled-586-588-carrier-fold-precision40
python3.12 -B research/rank7-coupled-586-588-carrier-fold-precision40/reproduce.py \
  --repo /path/to/full-repository-with-source-objects \
  --work /tmp/rank7-precision40-replay --jobs 2
```

Both rational moment engines certify the 40-digit lower endpoint, and the exact comparator proves the increase over PR #3133. The full source-export, native, replica-admission and outer-release replay passed; receipts bind the exact words, allocation, claim and manifest. The run reused only the authenticated, hash-checked retained bootstrap/cache. Adjacent-grid and negative controls reject; the precision-30 candidate was not released. No independent human review or full multiplication theorem is claimed.

## Credit

This follow-up changes only the endpoint report and replay package. PR #3133's construction and full contributor lineage remain credited in `CREDITS.md`; PR #3136's independent audit is cited above. Precision-40 refinement by Gonzalo Mier with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Can precision increase further before the independent 192-bit interval enclosure limits the endpoint? Bound the root interval width and test the next endpoint grid with strict negative controls.
2. Can a literal T740 allocation close the inherited `1.4053e-9` integer-rounding gap and reach the fixed-inventory cap near `0.001729777494678597`? Port this verified profile through its actual owner chronology and rerun the complete supplier invoice.
3. Can a changed frame/warp contract unlock the transverse-cone lock on helpers 584 and 590 without returning the savings in restoration? Construct one chronological `B_WARP` change and price all affected children.
